howToApply: Visit the official recruitment portal: www.hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in

howToApply: Visit the official BEL website: https://bel-india.in and click the relevant link against the advertisement.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 400/- plus 18% GST through SBI Collect (online mode or SBI Branch). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from fee payment.
Note the SBI Collect Reference Number generated after payment.
Fill in the online application form carefully with all required details.

Upload all required self-attested documents including SSLC/Matriculation Certificate, PUC/12th/Diploma marks card, BE/B.Tech marks cards for all semesters, Provisional/Final BE/B.Tech Degree Certificate, CGPA conversion formula (if applicable), post-qualification experience certificates, category/disability/EWS certificates (if applicable), NOC (if working in PSU/Govt. organization), SBI fee payment receipt, and write-up of roles and responsibilities/experience.
Submit the online application before 23.09.2026.
